description: What Excel does with an array formula's range holding another formula, with two array formulas' ranges sharing a cell, and with the edits that make either. ts-xlsx wrote each shape, authored directly and produced by its own row edits, and every package was opened interactively. Separately, Excel performed the same edits over COM on a workbook of its own, reporting whether it refused each and what the sheet held after.
probe: .claude/skills/excel-gui-automation/scripts/open-verdict.ps1 per package; a one-off COM script performing each edit (Rows.Insert, Rows.Delete, Columns.Insert, Columns.Delete, Range.Copy, Range.FormulaArray, Range.Formula) and reading HasArray, CurrentArray, HasSpill and SpillingToRange

openVerdicts.legacy B1:B3, then duplicateRow(1): repair-prompt, written as B1:B4 beside B2:B5
openVerdicts.legacy B1:B3 with B2 a value, then dupli: clean, written as B1:B4 with values in B2 and B3
openVerdicts.legacy B1:B3, then insertRow(2) carrying: repair-prompt, written as B1:B4 with the formula in B2
openVerdicts.dynamic B1:B3, then insertRow(2) carryin: repair-prompt, written as dynamic B1:B4 with the formula in B2

legacy B1:B3.insert row 1, above: allowed; the array moves to B2:B4
legacy B1:B3.insert row 2 or rows 2:3, inside: refused: You can't change part of an array.
legacy B1:B3.insert column B, at its column: allowed; the array moves to C1:C3
legacy B1:B3.copy row 3 onto row 4, or insert it at r: allowed; B4 becomes a one-cell array formula of its own
legacy B1:B3.FormulaArray over B2:B4: refused: Unable to set the FormulaArray property
legacy B1:B3.Formula into B2: reported no error and changed nothing: B2 is still a member of B1:B3

legacy B1:C3.insert column B, its left edge: allowed; the array moves to C1:D3

dynamic B1 spilling over B1:B3.insert row 2: allowed; the formula becomes A1:A4*2 and spills over B1:B4
dynamic B1 spilling over B1:B3.insert row 1 copied at row 2: allowed; B1 shows #SPILL!, B2 spills over B2:B5

repairs: open-verdict.ps1 accepted each repair but could not save Excel's recovery: under pwsh 7 it has no Marshal.GetActiveObject, so what Excel recovers from these packages is unobserved
verdict: An array formula's range, legacy or dynamic, may hold no other formula and share no cell with another array formula's range; a member cell holding a value is what the formula produced. Excel refuses any edit cutting through a legacy range: an insert strictly inside it, a delete taking part of it, a row copied onto or into it. It allows an edit that moves the whole range or removes it whole. It allows the same edits through a dynamic array, whose spill it then blocks. Locked by the corpus case an-array-formula-range-holds-no-other-formula.
